cohort: 213 mothers (49 healthy and 164 with preeclampsia) whose neonates were admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit
finding: Neonates of mothers with preeclampsia had a higher rate of premature rupture of membranes, cesarean delivery, and retinopathy of prematurity compared to neonates of healthy mothers.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rate was higher in neonates of mothers with preeclampsia.
